answer: Each challenge is cryptographically entangled with a future, unpredictable drand quicknet threshold-BLS pulse and a domain-separated commitment, so its input is fixed only after participants commit. Anyone can verify the pulse and derivation, but answers cannot be precomputed or stockpiled by offline sybil swarms; a task may trace a river, open a vault, or reach a summit. This limits advance grinding and replay, not identity creation itself.
